description: Django is a Python web framework with routing, views, forms and data tools. These first lessons focus on simple views. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install django~=5.2, run django-admin startproject school, then enter school. Replace school/urls.py with each example and run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. These view examples need no database tables.
versionNote: Examples use Django 5.2 LTS and Python 3.10 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Make a text view with Django
Read a name from the path with Django
Build a URL from its name with Django
Return a list safely with Django
learningObjectives: Make a text view with Django
Read a query string with Django
Return an error status with Django
